minutes_text:
REGULAR MEETING OF THE BOARD OF SUPERVISORS
  ORANGE COUNTY, CALIFORNIA

  Tuesday, June 11, 2024,9 : 3 0 A . M .

  BOARD HEARING ROOM, FIRST FLOOR
  400 W. Civic Center Drive
  Santa Ana, California

  DONALD P. WAGNER
  CHAIRMAN
  Third District

 DOUG CHAFFEE  ANDREW DO
 VICE CHAIRMAN  SUPERVISOR
 Fourth District  First District

 VICENTE SARMIENTO  KATRINA
 SUPERVISOR  FOLEY
 Second District  SUPERVISOR
  Fifth District
ATTENDANCE:All Present

EXCUSED:None

 PRESENT:  COUNTY EXECUTIVE OFFICER  Frank Kim
  COUNTY COUNSEL  Leon J. Page
  CLERK OF THE BOARD  Robin Stieler

INVOCATION:Supervisor Foley, Fifth District, gave the invocation

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:Supervisor Do, First District, led the assembly in the Pledge of Allegiance

I.PRESENTATIONS/INTRODUCTIONS (None)

II.CONSENT CALENDAR (None)
  END OF CONSENT CALENDAR

III.DISCUSSION ITEMS (Item 1)

GENERAL ADMINISTRATION

 1.  County Executive Office - Approve continuation of Local Emergency for the Navy Hangar
  Fire; and set review to determine need for continuing local emergency for 7/23/24, 9:30 a.m.
   and every 60 days thereafter until terminated - All Districts (Continued from Special
  Meeting, 11/13/23, Item 1; 1/9/24, Item 25; 2/27/24, Item 40; 4/23/24, Item 28)
 54123  APPROVED AS RECOMMENDED

IV.PUBLIC HEARINGS (Item 2)

GENERAL ADMINISTRATION

 2.  County Executive Office - Hold Public Hearing to consider adoption of FY 2024-25
  Recommended Budget - All Districts
  A. Opening Remarks
  B. Executive Summary
  C. Public Comments
  D. Board Comments
  E. Program I Public Protection
  F. Program II Community Services
  G. Program III Infrastructure & Environmental Resources
  H. Program IV General Government
  I. Program V Capital Improvements
  J. Program VI Debt Services
  K. Program VII Insurance, Reserves & Miscellaneous
  L. Executive Recap
  M. Closing Remarks
  (All or part of which may be considered on 6/12/24)
  Set final budget adoption for June 25, 2024, 9:30 a.m.
 B.O.  CLOSED PUBLIC HEARING

 14253  CONTINUED TO 6/25/24, 9:30 A.M. FOR FINAL ADOPTION OF THE 2024-2025
  BUDGET

V.CLOSED SESSION (Items SCS1-SCS2)

GENERAL ADMINISTRATION

  County Executive Office:

 SCS1.  PUBLIC EMPLOYEE APPOINTMENT - Pursuant to Government Code Section
  54957(b):
  Title: County Executive Officer
 B.O.  HELD, NO REPORTABLE ACTION

 SCS2.  CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATOR - Pursuant to Government Code
  Section 54957.6:
  Agency Negotiator: Colette Farnes
  Unrepresented Employee: County Executive Officer
 B.O.  HELD, NO REPORTABLE ACTION

VI.PUBLIC, CEO, ADJOURNMENT & BOARD COMMENTS

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
   Ilya Tseglin - Oral re: County attorneys are corrupted; Public Defenders assigned by judges
  misrepresent defenders, violate the rules of law and lie in court; Public Defenders are in cahoots with
  corrupted judges to make a ruling profitable to them; violation of rules of law; Public Defender
  assigned to his probate case lied in court when he said his son said he didn't want to live with his
  family; private attorney provided accurate information in court

COUNTY EXECUTIVE OFFICER COMMENTS:
 None

ADJOURNED:12:45 P.M.

BOARD COMMENTS:
 None

  Left Margin Notes

  1. = Supervisor Do  A.=Abstained
  2. = Supervisor Sarmiento  X.=Excused
  3. = Supervisor Wagner  N.=No

  5. = Supervisor Foley

  ORD.= Ordinance
  RESO. = Resolution

  Above numbers refer to Supervisorial Districts (1st number = Moved by; 2nd number = Seconded by)

  Chairman, Orange County Board of
  Supervisors

Orange County Clerk of the Board
